Unraid plugins by **nonkronk**.
- **RTX 3090 Unlock**: Unraid packaging of Zagitta's GPU Unlock, restoring full-rate FP16/BF16 Tensor Core issue on NVIDIA GA102/GA104 GPUs. Experimental; tested on RTX 3090 with Unraid 7.3.4.
Support, bug reports and questions: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/nonkronk/unraid-3090-unlock/issues).
